name: finolabs-vibecode
description: 20 skills and 3 agents (fnl-reviewer, fnl-security-reviewer, fnl-navigator) for review routing, verification, setup, run hygiene and quota on demand.

interface.longDescription: 20 skills and three read-only agents: fnl-reviewer, fnl-security-reviewer and fnl-navigator. Route coding work, assign review families, post guarded reviews and verify delegated work with current-head receipts before ledger acceptance. A small host judge is the default; optional Jev uses the scoped network exception and disclosed fallback. Use $fnl-setup for Quick defaults or Advanced interviews, add <feature>, instructions, check, scan and mode. Keep headless runs allowlisted, lint briefs and scan logs locally. Read quota on demand and track project progress per repository; retain handovers through fnl-session-hygiene.
defaultPrompt: Route this change through the coding router and tell me the depth you chose.
Use fnl-delegate to coordinate this spec with one session per task.
Use $fnl-setup to choose Quick or Advanced, then show add <feature>, instructions and check.
Use $fnl-setup scan to refresh my local agent inventory, then $fnl-setup mode to show effective settings.
